terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: One piece of the PEDESTRIAN OVERPASS set, built to the modular contract in the registry notes: a span module runs 8 m along Z with its pivot at the centre of the deck UNDERSIDE and is placed at y = 5.5 to put its walking surface at 6.0; a stair flight rises 3.0 m over 4 m from its foot at the pivot; columns and landings carry their seats at 5.5 or 6.0 to match. Nothing opens, turns or swings; nothing attaches. One root pivot and zero sockets is the whole contract, and every end face is flat and square so chained pieces never z-fight. The covered BMA span: the open steel span with portal posts and a shallow corrugated gable over it, in the blue paint some districts use.

reasoning: 4 component(s) on 4 material(s), 4 draw calls of 12.
Three materials: paint, the plan-mapped floor, and zinc so the roof canvas can run its corrugations at their real pitch.
No repetition system: nothing on this piece repeats often enough to earn one.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, a derived compound, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the roofed portal over the open span: posts, head beams and two raked sheets, all boxes; corrugation, chalk and rust are canvas.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 2.80 x 4.20 x 8.00 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=16000 triangles, <=12 draw calls, <=8 materials, <=16 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; none collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

pivotInventory.name: root
pivotInventory.justification: The rigid body of the prop at its declared origin. A named pivot is a promise that a part turns on it, and only real mechanisms get one.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.
actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

silhouette.description: A 2.8 x 4.2 section 8 m long: girders and floor as the open span, posts on two lines to an eave at 3.55, a gable to 4.12 overhanging 0.10.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x: the girders' outer faces plus the handrail. y 0 at the deck UNDERSIDE, which is the pivot -- placed at 5.5 the walking surface lands at 6.0. z +-4: the 8 m module with vertical end plates, so two modules butt with no overlap and nothing to z-fight. Portal posts on the girders at z = -4 and 0 only (the +4 line belongs to the next module) rise to an eave at 3.55 under a shallow gable of corrugated sheet whose ridge is the 4.2 m top; 2.8 m over the eaves.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Meshy v7 proxy (scratch/pedestrian-bridge-roofed-steel-span/reference.glb) is read for the SECTION and the part proportions only: the plan and the seat heights are the contract. Where the proxy and the notes disagree the notes win and the disagreement is recorded here.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. These are symmetric modules: the far girder, balustrade or handrail is the near one mirrored, which the plate confirms wherever both sides show.

evidence: Measured on region-girder: the plate reads #6c7175 (luma 112). textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the hero2x class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: 4 component(s) + 0 repetition system(s) = 4 of 12. Parts that share a material ride one merged geometry and one submission.

materials.note: 3 of 8: every tone inside a material is a vertex colour or a canvas ratio over its envelope, never a second material.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 700 of 16000, measured off the built module by render-model.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Tinted boxes, extruded (x, y) profiles and profile SWEEPS along a straight, sheared or arced path merged per material; cylinders where the plate shows a round section.
No InstancedMesh: nothing on this piece repeats enough to earn one. In a level the HOST instances the whole module.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.

Every material is declared textureless. Surface identity is one post-construction canvas tile per material -- cast concrete with a form-tie grid, lift lines and pinholes; asphalt with its lane marks; painted steel with rust -- bound as map and bump after construction, so createObjectModel does no per-pixel work but the tiles.

Repair gable slope direction: eaves y=3.64, ridge y=4.16; actual 0.20 m corrugations with closed underside. Four supported portal frames at z=-3.9,-1.3,1.3,3.9. Floor, girders, posts and rails share x=+-1.10 support lines; no floating columns. Added continuous eave beams, sloped rafters and ridge cap. Reduced weathering contrast; zinc texture describes finish rather than fake striped roof relief.

risks.mitigation: allow_holes is set on a scratch/_holecc.mjs measurement recorded in the gate log: the enclosed components are the rail openings, many pixels thick, not anti-aliased edges; the silhouette ratios at 0/180 are read in the same log.
